## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Compatibility and data

Describe protocol compatibility and any change to data collection, storage, identity, retention, or external requests.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run minify`
- [ ] `npm run docs`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] PHP syntax was checked when PHP changed
- [ ] Types, API, protocol, and privacy documentation are updated where relevant
- [ ] The change contains no demo HTML or unrelated generated assets
